review_questions: Which milestone did this advance, block, or leave unchanged?
What design/work-product became executable, integrated, or explicitly unchanged?
What is the closeout posture: implementation checkpoint, claim-bearing, or promotion?
For claim-bearing or promotion closeouts, what evidence and claim-boundary state changed?
Did accepted objective, DV plan, milestone, requirement, or claim-boundary state change or need review?
What is the next milestone-directed action?
review_policy: Every closeout should answer the review questions as a compact delta and should update ledgers only when accepted campaign state changes. Production design deltas should foreground executable design/work-product progress and efficient movement toward working silicon before evidence bookkeeping. Implementation-checkpoint closeouts do not require verifier review or claim advancement. Updates that affect claim scope, evidence scope, hard gates, or success criteria require verification-agent review. Promotion claims require initial-packet sign-off from the human silicon architect and DV engineer / verification owner. Controller-recorded narrowed-scope exceptions authorize non-promotion discovery or implementation with explicit non-claims only.

milestones.title: Campaign subtree initialized
milestones.exit_criteria: Campaign scaffold exists on a campaign branch

milestones.title: Objective, working capability target, and acceptance boundary recorded
milestones.exit_criteria: For promotion, objective, working capability target, executable design deliverable, readiness ladder, requirements, baselines, hard gates, preferences, diagnostics, non-claims, and authority are recorded with human silicon architect sign-off. A controller-recorded narrowed-scope exception may record the construction boundary only for non-promotion discovery or implementation

milestones.title: DV/evidence plan supports the capability target and design deliverable
milestones.exit_criteria: Full initial DV/evidence plan is reviewable at campaign resolution, covers the working capability target, executable deliverable/readiness ladder, identifies unblocked construction work, and is approved by the DV engineer / verification owner before promotion claims

milestones.title: Initial campaign packet resolved
milestones.exit_criteria: For promotion, initial-packet.md records human silicon architect and DV engineer / verification-owner sign-offs. An explicit controller-recorded narrowed-scope exception may resolve the packet only for non-promotion discovery or implementation with explicit non-claims

milestones.title: First meaningful executable design increment
milestones.exit_criteria: A meaningful RTL, model, BFM, generated-collateral, interface, or integration increment exists, can be locally exercised, and materially reduces distance to the working capability target. This advances construction only; promotion claims still require the M1-M3 gates and verifier-owned evidence

milestones.title: Exact RTL and DV boundary candidate
milestones.exit_criteria: Centralized physical-footprint validation, directed boundary sequence, model/scoreboard agreement, no-data-request checking, testplan/config entries, and documentation form one reviewable candidate.

milestones.title: Static and focused directed checks recorded
milestones.exit_criteria: DMA Verilator lint, DV lint, and the narrowest available Xilinx simulation are recorded with exact pending gaps.

milestones.title: Campaign checkpoint closeout
milestones.exit_criteria: Campaign artifacts record work completed, evidence, branch state, verifier findings, claim boundary, and remaining verification.

milestones.title: Complete no-request verification and run full directed UVM
milestones.exit_criteria: Strict interrupt-clear suppression is implemented and focused-check evidence is recorded; exit still requires the directed sequence on a supported UVM simulator and independent review of the exact candidate.
